chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, note kiangah kong hilh ngei mah bangin na san’ uh a, na belh uh Lungdamna Thu kong zasak kik ding hi.
Tu-ma a, thu kong hilh thu in a mawkna hi ci loin umin na lungkip uh leh, tua thu hangin gupna na ngah ding uh hi.
Ka ngah bangin note kiangah ka hong gen masak thu in: Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin Khazih in eite mawhna taang ding sihna a thuak hi.
A kivui khit ciangin Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, nithum ni-in a thokik hi.
Kefas kiangah a kilat khit ciangin sawm-le-nihte kiangah a kilang hi.
Tua nung ciangin ute naute za nga tham lote kiangah thakhatin a kilang hi. Tuate a tampi in tudong a nungta lai uh hi. Kimkhat a si zo uh hi.
Tua nung ciangin Jeim kiangah a kilang hi. Tua nung ciangin sawltakte khempeuh kiangah a kilang hi.
A nunung belin a hun cing lopi-a suak keima kiangah hong kilang hi.
Keimah in a beisa hunin Pasian’ pawlpite a bawlsiapa ka hih ciangin a neubel sawltak ka hi a, sawltak kici dinga kilawm ka hi kei hi.

Ahih hangin Pasian’ hehpihna thupha hangin ka hi bangin ka hi hi. Ka ngahsa hehpihna thupha a mawkna ahi kei hi, sawltakte khempeuh sangin hahkat zaw-in ka sem hi. Tua bang ka cih hangin kei a hahkat ka hi kei hi; keimah tawh a omkhawm Pasian’ hehpihna thupha in a hahkat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei ka hi zongin, amau ahi zongin tua bangin ka hilh uh a, tua mah bangin note in zong na um uh hi.
Tu-in Khazih in sihna pan a thawhkikna thu a kihilh ciangin, “Misite thawhkikna a om kei hi,” ci-in note lakah mi kimkhat in bang hangin a ci uh hiam?
Misite’ thawhkikna om lo hi leh, Khazih zong a thokik kei ding hi.
Khazih thokik lo hi leh, kote’ thuhilhna a mawkna ahi hi. Note upna zong a mawkna ahi hi.

Tua tham loin, kote in Pasian thu hilhna panin zuau teci ka hi ding uh hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, misite thokik lo hi leh, Pasian in Khazih a thokik sak kei ding hi. Tu-in Khazih a thokik sak hi ci-in Pasian ading teci ka hi uh hi.
Misite a thokik lo hi leh, Khazih zong a thokik kei ding hi.
Khazih a thokik lo hi leh, na upna uh a mawkna ahi hi; mawhna khialhna sungah a om lai na hi uh hi.
Tua tham loin, Khazih’ thu-um a sisate in zong a mangthang ahi ding uh hi.
Eite in hih leitung nuntakna sung ading bek a, Khazih sungah lawpna nei i hih leh, mi khempeuh sangin a hehpih huaizaw mi i hi ding hi.
Tu-in Khazih in misite lakah a gah masabel suak a, sihna pan a thokik zo hi.
Tua ahih tak ciangin mi khat hangin sihna thu a piang mah bangin misi thawhkikna thu in zong mi khat hangin a piang ahi hi.
Adam sungah mi khempeuh a sih mah bangin Khazih sungah mi khempeuh a nungta uh hi.
Ahih hangin mi khempeuh in amau hun bang a zui ciat ding uh hi. Khazih in a gah masa bel ahi hi. Tu nung ciangin Khazih hong pai ciangin ama mite in thawhkikna a ngah ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin Khazih in ukna aana leh vangliatna apawl pawlte khempeuh siangsakin Pa Pasian tungah Gam a piak khit ciangin leitung a bei ding hi.
Pasian in galte khempeuh ama khe nuai-ah a khiat khit dong matengin Khazih in a maang ding hi.
A khakbel a gal ahi sihna mangpa in lelhna a thuak ding hi.

“Na khempeuh ama khe nuai-ah a khia hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh hi. Ahih hangin, “Na khempeuh a khia hi,” a cih ciangin na khempeuh Khazih’ nuai-ah a khiatsakpa Pasian a om lai hi cih a kilang hi.
Na khempeuh Khazih nuai-ah a khiat khit ciangin na khempeuh ama nuai-ah a khiapa, Pasian’ ukna, Tapa in zong a mang ding hi. Tua ahih ciangin Pasian in na khempeuh ah na khempeuh ahi ding hi.
Ahih kei leh, misite tang ding bang hangin kibaptaiz ahi uh hiam? Misite a thokik lo takpi ahih leh, amaute tang ding bang hangin a kibaptaiz uh hiam?
Kote in zong hong tung ding gimna tawh bang hangin kituak niloh ka hi uh hiam?
Ute naute aw, keimah in nisimin sihna ka thuak hi ci-in i Topa Zeisu Khazih sungah note hangin kisathei-in, lungdamin ka hong gen nuam hi.
Leitung ngeina bangin Efesa khua ah sahangte tawh ka kitot hangin bang lawhtak ka hi hiam? Mi sisate thokik lo ding ahih leh, ‘Ne ni, dawn ni, zing ciangin i si ding hi.’
Na kikheem kei un, ‘Mipha lote tawh kikholhna hangin gamtatna pha kisia thei hi.
Note kimkhat in Pasian kitheih mawhbawl na hih uh ciangin kilehkik un, mawhna hih nawn kei un – tua bang ka cih ciangin note zum nadingin kong ci hi.
“Misite bangci-in thokik ding uh ahi hiam? Bang ci pumpi hong suak ding uh hiam?” ci-in mi kimkhat in hong dong uh hi.
Lungpil lo mi aw, nang na tuh khaici in a kisiat kei leh, a hing thei kei ding hi.
Khaici na tuh uh ciangin a nung ciangin a hong piang ding a kungpi pen a tuhpah na hi kei uh hi. Mangbuh ahi zongin, buh dangte ahi zongin a tang taktak na tuh uh hi.
Pasian in a deih bangin tua tang kung a pia hi; khaici a vekpi-in amau pawl bangin kung a pia ciat hi.
Sa khempeuh nam khat bek ahi kei hi. Mihing’ sa namkhat, ganhing’ sa namkhat, vasa namkhat, ngasa namkhat atuamtuam a om ciat uh hi.
Vantung pumpite a om uh hi, leitung pumpite a om uh hi. Vantung pumpite’ vangliatna pawl khat, leitung pumpite’ vangliatna nam khat a om ciat hi.
Ni a vangliatna a om hi, kha a vangliatna a om hi, aksite a vangliatna a om hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, aksite a vangliatna in atuam tuamin a kilamdang hi.
Tua mah bangin misite a thawhkikna thu ahi hi. Pumpi a kituh ciangin muat theihna a om hi. A thawhkik ciangin muat theih lohna a om hi.
A kituh ciangin maizum theihna a om hi, a thawhkik ciangin minthan’na tawh a dim hi. A kivui ciangin thahatna a om kei hi, a thawhkik ciangin thahatna tawh a dim hi.
A kituh ciangin leitung pumpi ahi hi. A thawhkik ciangin kha pumpi ahi hi. Leitung pumpi a om leh, kha pumpi zong a om hi.
Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelh mah bangin, “A masa bel Adam in a nungta mihing a suak hi,” kici hi. A nunung bel Adam in nuntakna a pia thei kha a suak hi.
Ahih hangin kha pumpi a piang masa hi lo hi. Leitung pumpi a piang masa hi. A nung ciangin kha pumpi a piang hi.
A masa bel mi in lei pan hong piang ahih ciangin leitung mi ahi hi. A nihna mi in vantung pan a hong piang hi.
Leitung mite in leitungmite tawh kibang hi. Vantungmite in vantungmite tawh a kibang hi.
Eite in leitungmi’ lim i neih mah bangin vantungmi’ lim i nei ding hi.
Ute naute aw, ke’n kong cih-inah, si-le-sa in Pasian’ Gam a luah zo kei ding hi. A muat theite in a muat theih lohna a luah zo kei ding hi.
En un, thuthuk khat kong gen ding hi. Eite khempeuh sicip ding i hi kei hi.

A nunung peengkul a hong mut ciangin tomkha sung mitphiat kikalin eite khempeuh i kikheel ding hi. Tua peengkul a mut ding a, misite in muat thei nawn lo dingin hong thokik ding uh hi. Eite khempeuh in zong i kikheel khin ding hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, hih a muat theite in muat theih lohna a silh ding hi.
Hih muat theihna in muat theih lohna silh a, hih sih theihna in sih theih lohna a silh ciangin, “Zawhna sungah sihna kivalh tum zo hi” ci-a Lai Siangtho sungah a kigelhsa thu in a tangtung ding hi.
‘Sihna aw, na zawhna koi lai-ah om hiam? Sihna aw, na gu koi lai-ah a om hiam?’
Sihna’ gu in mawhna ahi hi.
Mawhna’ vangliatna in thukham ahi hi. Ahih hangin i Topa Zeisu Khazih hanga eite zawhna hong pia Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka it ka ute ka naute aw, Topa’ nasep na hahkatna uh in Pasian tungah a mawkna hi lo hi cih thei na hih ciangun lungkipin, kicingin, kiam loin, hoi loin hahkat-in sem un.
